import nanosurf

import glob

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()

# Get list of files before scan

print(f"Files before scan: {len(files_before)}")

# Start scan (using StartFrameUp for bottom-to-top scanning)
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Wait a moment for file to be saved
time.sleep(2)

# Get list of files after scan
files_after = set(glob.glob(os.path.join(current_dir, '*.nid')))
print(f"Files after scan: {len(files_after)}")

# Find the new file
new_files = files_after - files_before
if new_files:
    new_file = list(new_files)[0]
    print(f"New file created: {new_file}")
    print(f"Absolute path: {os.path.abspath(new_file)}")
else:
    print("No new file detected, checking all files...")
    all_files = list(files_after)
    if all_files:
        # Get the most recent file
        latest_file = max(all_files, key=os.path.getmtime)
        print(f"Latest file: {latest_file}")
        print(f"Absolute path: {os.path.abspath(latest_file)}")

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get all necessary objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Dynamic AFM (minimizes tip damage)
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.DynamicAFM
print(f"Operating mode set to: Dynamic AFM")

# Set scan parameters for 20x20 µm² with 128x128 resolution
scan.ImageWidth = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Image size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"  Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines} points")

# Set a filename for the scan
file_name = "topography_20x20um_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)
print(f"Filename mask set to: {file_name}")

# Start the scan (bottom to top)
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("\nScanning finished!")

# Clean up
del spm

print("\nScan completed successfully.")

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get all necessary objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Dynamic AFM (minimizes tip damage)
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.DynamicAFM
print(f"Operating mode set to: {opmode.OperatingMode}")

# Set scan parameters for 30x30 µm² area
scan.ImageWidth = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Width: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm")
print(f"  Height: {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm")
print(f"  Points: {scan.Points}")
print(f"  Lines: {scan.Lines}")

# Set a filename prefix
file_name = "topographic_scan_30um_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)
print(f"Filename mask set to: {file_name}")

# Start the scan
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("\nScanning finished!")

# Try to get the saved file path
try:
    # Check if there's a method to get the last saved file
    if hasattr(application, 'LastSavedFile'):
        saved_path = application.LastSavedFile
        print(f"Saved file path: {saved_path}")
    elif hasattr(application, 'GetLastSavedFile'):
        saved_path = application.GetLastSavedFile()
        print(f"Saved file path: {saved_path}")
    else:
        print("Checking application attributes...")
        attrs = [attr for attr in dir(application) if not attr.startswith('_')]
        print(f"Available attributes: {attrs[:20]}...")  # Print first 20
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting saved file: {e}")

del spm

import os

# Load application

# Get all necessary objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Dynamic AFM (minimizes tip damage)
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.DynamicAFM
print(f"Operating mode set to: DynamicAFM")

# Set scan parameters for 30x30 µm² area
scan.ImageWidth = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm")
print(f"  Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm")
print(f"  Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"  Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")

file_name = "topographic_scan_30um_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

# Start the scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()  # Scanning from bottom to top

while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")

print("Scanning finished!")

    scan_path = latest_file
else:
    print("No .nid files found in workspace")
    scan_path = None

del spm

print(f"\nFinal scan path: {scan_path}")

import nanosurf
import time

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

print("Starting AFM scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

del spm
